purpose: Build many editable 2D objects in one existing Native Stage without author-managed GPU buffers.
entry: scene2D(init, group({id:'root', children:[rect({id:'box', width:120, height:80, fill:solid('#51bcff')})]}))
inputs: Existing Native initialization and named Stage image inputs or sealed Resources; explicit viewport and optional borrowed admitted services.
output: CreationStage whose renderAt produces the existing F16/F32 scene-linear Rec709 premultiplied image; caller owns returned image.

parameters.coordinates: Local px, top-left/Y-down; optional viewBox; degrees; parent times child transform.
parameters.animation: Existing Signal and FrameContext; no independent clock or automatic replay of ordinary JS edits.

maxBytes.meaning: Configured per-plan budget, additionally constrained by actual device; not measured physical peak.

geometryTolerance.meaning: Ellipse/path geometric error in local px.

gradientPixelsPerUnit.meaning: Explicit float gradient atlas spatial sampling quality; no hidden input image resizing.

independentImplementation: Canvas-shaped recording into the same tree
strict SVG source adapter with primitive fills, groups, affine/viewBox, gradients, declared images and rectangular clips
delegatedPendingAssets: tight curved bounds / morph require explicitly supplied borrowed providers
notYetImplemented: SVG text and full browser typography/Canvas compliance
delegatedImplemented: Original PA font shaping/itemization, actual metrics, glyph fill/stroke meshes
Original Clipper2 path fill/stroke and canonicalization via admitted R1 assets

limits: Current Pixel ABI batches up to three distinct source images plus the index map; larger lists split in painter order.
Actual texture/dispatch/storage capabilities and byte budgets apply.
Existing Graphics-v1 path/glyph profiles remain unchanged.
Missing admitted path/text services fail explicitly; no fake glyphs, hidden Servo or SDR fallback.
Canvas-shaped subset is not a DOM Canvas implementation: clearRect, non-source-over compositing, two-circle radial gradients and equal-offset hard stops reject explicitly.
Canvas real measureText/fillText are asynchronous and require admitted actual text services and FrameContext.
Layout ignores visual transforms for sizing; text constraints await real measurements. No fake font or character-count sizing.
Flexily0.8.3(MIT) adapted only to remove optional module logger probes and integer device-pixel snapping; Node layout operates in float logical px.

SVG profile rejects DTD/entities, scripts/events, external unresolved resources, CSS stylesheets, filters/masks/pattern/use, nested SVG viewports, focal radial/hard-stop gradients and objectBoundingBox clip units. It never silently rasterizes.
SVG raw colors are sRGB inputs converted to existing float scene-linear paint; editable native object paints can use signed/HDR linear numeric colors.
lifecycle: Create once at Native Stage initialization; await renderAt before update/dispose; Core owns queue completion and device recovery; release output separately.
dependencies: existing CreationStage, GPU resource arena, Pixel/Compute/mesh raster
existing PA path/text services when needed

defaultAssets.font: Noto Sans SC / wght400 / zh-Hans / Hani / OFL-1.1
defaultAssets.loader: Existing sealed R1 ModuleLoader and original PA Kit clients
defaultAssets.permission: Explicit --allow-wasm; primitives do not need it
defaultAssets.outputs: Original PA outlines/metrics -> existing Native float premultiplied mesh rendering
limits: Wrapped tracking needs explicit PA reflow
curveFactory and morph remain explicit borrowed services
defaultAssets.lifecycle: Per-scene owned clients/cache; scene disposal before providers. Explicit supplied services remain borrowed. Cancellation cooperative, scoped native-first ponyfill.
defaultAssets.qualification: Runtime candidate0.4.6 verified; final guide corrections are documentation only and await Main package rebuild/runtime-pin review
